name: Feature request
about: A check, an adapter, or a format change that would make ctxverify more useful
title: ""
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

**What you want to check**

The problem you want a rule to catch. A concrete failure mode is worth more
than a category name.

**Why the current rules do not catch it**

If one of the existing rules is close but not quite right, say which one and
where it falls short. `docs/rules.md` lists all sixteen.

**What a finding would look like**

The rule id, the severity, and roughly the message.

**A pack that triggers it**

If you have one, that is the most useful thing you can bring.
